parse_unicode_table: parse a Unicode data file into code points and fields using ReadUnicodeTable with a callback
get_case_folding_groups: get Unicode case folding groups by calling CaseGroups to retrieve fold-equivalent code point lists
get_unicode_scripts: get a dict mapping script names to code point lists by calling Scripts on Unicode data
get_unicode_categories: get a dict mapping Unicode category names to code point lists by calling Categories on Unicode data
convert_hex_to_codepoint: convert a hex string like 263A to a Unicode code point integer using the _UInt helper
